results.rationale: Consistency: the white background, gray material, fluted shafts, square capitals and descending row remain, but the row is enlarged and spread differently across the frame. Instruction: the source has eight columns and the edit still has eight; the expected five-column arrangement is absent, so the requested count change is not followed. Quality: structural coherence, natural shading, artifact freedom and surface fidelity are satisfactory; the columns form a coherent illustration with no clear structural defects.

Consistency: excluding the requested background, reflections, positioning and typography changes, the red Ferrari and front three-quarter view remain, but the front wheel spoke pattern and grille emblem/detail are visibly altered. Instruction: the car is placed below center against dark blurred light trails with cool reflections and top-left/bottom-center text. The expected design also requires the exact silver-gray headline and Ferrari name; both strings are malformed, the headline is dark on a white banner, and the background conveys motion lights more clearly than an identifiable urban nightscape. This is partial compliance. Quality: car structure, lighting and paint are broadly coherent, but the visibly garbled headline and brand lettering are two clear semantic artifacts.
